description: Source code for GPIO driver for NXP SC18IM704 device in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, read/write, and port control functions.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_set_raw
methods.description: Sets raw GPIO port bits with mask, value, and toggle options.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures individual GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_pin_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration flags for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the current raw value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits specified by mask to a value.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specified bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specified bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specified bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_sc18im_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, checking parent device readiness.
